title: Te Whakapuakitanga i Toremitia
intro: Whakaarohia tētahi rangatira kaha e karapotia ana e te kororia, ngā whakamaharatanga, me ngā ope taua e ngohengohe ana ki te whakahau kotahi. I kī tēnei tangata he mana teitei tōna, i whakakore i ngā tohu atua hei mānukanuka, ā, i whakahau i tētahi whainga mutunga kore ki te moana. Whāia te ara mai i ngā ture whakakake ki ngā wai wehe, te wāhi e tae mai ai te whakaae whakamutunga kua roa rawa hei whakaora.
clues: I a au te mana tino nui, ā, i meinga e au ngā tamariki a Iharaira hei pononga māku.
I kī ahau ko ahau te ariki tino tiketike, ā, i whakakahore ki te whakaae ki tētahi atua i runga ake i ahau.
I whakahau ahau i a Hamana kia hanga he pourewa tiketike māku kia titiro atu ai ahau ki te Atua o Mohi.
I whakahē ahau i a Mohi rāua ko Harun i te mea i kawea mai e rāua ngā tohu mārama, ā, i kī ahau he makutu ā rāua merekara.
I te pō ka whaia e au a Mohi rātou ko te hunga whakapono me aku ope tae noa ki te moana.
I whakapuaki ahau i taku whakapono i a au e toremi ana i te moana, engari kua tomuri rawa, ā, i tiakina tōku tinana hei tohu.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga

I hanga e ia he āka hei oranga mō te waipuke nui
I moe i roto i te ana me ngā hoa mō ngā tau maha
I horomia e te ika nui i te hohonu
I toremi i a ia e whai ana i a Mohi me ngā Iharaira i roto i te moana kua wehea
trial.answer: I toremi i a ia e whai ana i a Mohi me ngā Iharaira i roto i te moana kua wehea
